integrity: The factorization and minimality are exact algebraic consequences of the stated hypotheses. The cubic-coefficient invariance is checked against the published extraction formulas and the source null-form proof. No computational experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only constant-coefficient scalar symmetric quadratic perturbations whose invisibility is enforced by the critical-critical and critical/second-harmonic symbol cancellations for every critical integer. It does not solve the full vector-valued quadratic/cubic classification problem.
title: Minimal-order classification of scalar quadratic null forms for cubic \(O(2)\)-Hopf coefficients
